title: The Ferry Rail and Two Sets of Elbows
youtube_title: The Ferry Rail and Two Sets of Elbows | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Friendship makes room before it keeps score.
summary: At a schoolyard with a low swing and a circle of stones, Farah is just outside the fun, close to a ferry rail with room for two sets of elbows. Quinn changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Farah has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Cousin Pio lets the children solve it.
